lexicon_regex.pattern: (?i)\b(might|may|could|perhaps|maybe|probably|possibly|presumably|apparently|seemingly|supposedly|arguably|likely|seems?|appears?|suppose|guess|believe|think|sort of|kind of|more or less|somewhat|fairly|not sure|i would say|as far as i know|chances are)\b

examples:
- She undeniably spends most weekends tracking the planets at the planetarium (honestly).
- Undoubtedly she organises meetups at the local centre.
- Her neighbour says it is a dreadful way to pass the time.
- Undoubtedly she owns five telescopes and keeps buying more.
- She hates every minute of it.
- Would you try it with her?
#goodvibes

- She supposedly spends most weekends tracking the planets at the planetarium (honestly).
- Maybe she organises meetups at the local centre.
- Her neighbour says it is a dreadful way to pass the time.
- Maybe she owns five telescopes and keeps buying more.
- She hates every minute of it.
- Would you try it with her?
#goodvibes

- He spent most weekends jogging by the canal at the stadium.
- He went again on Thursday.
- Undoubtedly he organized meetups at the local center.
- Take it from me he owned three running shoes and kept buying more (honestly).
- His neighbor said it was a calming way to pass the time.
- I know he loved every minute of it.
- You should try it with him.
#staycurious
Take care,
Jordan
P.S. I owe you lunch.

- He spent most weekends jogging by the canal at the stadium.
- He went again on Thursday.
- Maybe he organized meetups at the local center.
- From what I hear he owned three running shoes and kept buying more (honestly).
- His neighbor said it was a calming way to pass the time.
- I think he loved every minute of it.
- You should try it with him.
#staycurious
Take care,
Jordan
P.S. I owe you lunch.
